sources.note: Nothing. Publishes the entire c. 200-item Doornbos 1981 corpus with Chadic/Nilo-Saharan comparanda; the acute/grave accents on some Doornbos forms (kálámàdù, ɪbɪrí, féfè, rúwà, kuránu, jíà..) are reproduced without any comment on whether they mark stress or tone. Only occurrence of 'tone' is a footnote about Kera numeral data from Mary Pearce. Doornbos's Post scriptum (pp. 94-95) describes the 4-5 hour elicitation from a father-and-son pair and his own doubts about the data.
